parameters.query:
SELECT
  catalog.catalog_size,
  l.lesson_id, l.grade_label, l.grade_sort, l.unit,
  l.lesson_number, l.title,
  COALESCE(l.summary, '') AS summary,
  COALESCE(l.topic_tags, '') AS topic_tags,
  COALESCE(l.concepts, '') AS concepts,
  COALESCE(l.standards_raw, '') AS standards_raw,
  l.lesson_url,
  COALESCE(p.download_url, '') AS pdf_url
FROM (SELECT count(*)::int AS catalog_size FROM lessons WHERE status = 'Active') catalog
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT *
  FROM lessons
  WHERE status = 'Active'
    AND ($1 = '' OR grade_sort = NULLIF($1, '')::int)
    AND (
      $2 = ''
      OR upper(COALESCE(standards_raw, '')) LIKE '%' || upper($2) || '%'
    )
    AND (
      $3 = ''
      OR title ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
      OR COALESCE(topic_tags, '') ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
      OR COALESCE(theme, '') ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
      OR COALESCE(summary, '') ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
      OR COALESCE(unit, '') ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
    )
  ORDER BY grade_sort NULLS LAST, lesson_number
  LIMIT 5
) l ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT a.download_url FROM servable_assets a
   WHERE a.lesson_id = l.lesson_id AND a.is_primary
   LIMIT 1
) p ON true;
